asset.description:
Soviet Constructivist data visualization: Japan national debt as percentage of GDP, animated bar chart. 10 seconds total
VISUAL DESIGN (must match existing video palette)
Background: pure black #0a0a0a
Bar colors: solid red #CC0000 for bars, white #FFFFFF border on each bar
Year labels: grey #888888, bold, right-aligned
Value labels: white, bold, right of each bar
Title: "JAPAN DEBT / GDP" — white Impact font, large, top center, red drop shadow offset 3px
Subtitle: "% of GDP — 30 years of stimulus" — grey italic below title
Danger threshold line: dashed red #CC0000 at 100% mark, labelled "DANGER: 100%"
Big number "200%" pulses in bottom-right corner, red, enormous (120px), opacity 0.15 pulse
DATA (bars appear sequentially, left-to-right grow animation)
1991: 62%
1995: 87%
2000: 130%
2005: 175%
2010: 194%
2015: 198%
2020: 200%
ANIMATION SEQUENCE
Each bar row slides in from left with opacity 0→1 (staggered, 0.6s each)
Bar width grows from 0 to target width (1s ease, starts after row slides in)
Value label fades in after bar reaches full width
Danger line flashes on when 2000 bar exceeds it
"200%" big number pulses slowly throughout
Radiating conic gradient background lines (subtle gold #D4A853 at 4% opacity)
Two circular gear outlines top-left and bottom-right corners (grey 15% opacity, static)
LAYOUT
Canvas 1280×720
Chart area: top 160px, left 80px, width 1100px, height 480px
Bar height: 40px, gap 20px between bars
Year label column: 60px wide, right-aligned
Max bar width maps 200% → ~800px (fills ~73% of chart width)
Value labels positioned 10px right of bar end
STYLE CONSTRAINTS
Font: Impact, Arial Black, sans-serif throughout — NO other fonts
NO gradients on bars — solid flat color only
NO rounded corners — hard edges, industrial print feel
NO soft shadows — only hard offset text-shadow on title
Staircase echo NOT needed (this is data viz, not motion graphics)
Keep it large, clear, readable — minimum bar height 40px
Use the provided CSS as structural reference only. Implement cleanly with HTML/CSS/JS animations

asset.description:
Soviet Constructivist full-screen horizontal timeline infographic. 8 seconds. 1280x720. Standalone video — no transparency, complete solid background
BACKGROUND
Pure black #0a0a0a fills entire canvas (matches the preceding Japan debt chart)
Radiating conic lines: gold #D4A853 at 3% opacity, 6deg sectors, centered
Horizontal thick red diagonal accent stripe: #CC0000, 4px, runs from bottom-left to upper-right at 15deg, full canvas width, y≈580px — subtle constructivist energy line
TITLE (upper area, y=60px)
"THE IDEOLOGICAL BATTLE" in white, Arial Black bold, 28px, letter-spacing 4px
Hard red #CC0000 drop-shadow 3px offset right+down
Subtitle below: "1776 – 1944: how we got here" — grey #888, 15px italic
TIMELINE STRUCTURE (vertically centered at y=380px)
Gold horizontal line #D4A853, 5px thick, spanning x=80px to x=1200px
Two small gear circle wireframes (grey 12% opacity, hairline): 80px diameter at x=60px, 60px diameter at x=1220px
5 EVENT NODES evenly spaced (x positions: 130, 330, 530, 790, 1050)
NODE 1 — x=130, ABOVE line
Year: "1776" red #CC0000 bold 16px
Name: "ADAM SMITH" white Arial Black 15px
Desc: "The Wealth of Nations" grey 11px italic
Dot: 16px circle, gold #D4A853 fill, 2px white border
Stem: 2px white line, 55px UP from dot to box
Box: 2px solid gold border, black fill, 100px wide
NODE 2 — x=330, BELOW line
Year: "1871" orange #FF6600 bold 16px
Name: "MENGER" white Arial Black 15px
Desc: "Austrian School born" grey 11px italic
Dot: 16px circle, orange #FF6600 fill, 2px white border
Stem: 55px DOWN from dot
Box: 2px solid orange border, black fill
NODE 3 — x=530, ABOVE line
Year: "1920" orange #FF6600 bold 16px
Name: "HAYEK" white Arial Black 15px
Desc: "Business Cycle Theory" grey 11px italic
Dot: 16px circle, orange fill, 2px white border
Stem: 55px UP
Box: 2px solid orange border, black fill
NODE 4 — x=790, BELOW line: *** HERO NODE ***
Year: "1936" red #CC0000 bold 20px — larger
Name: "KEYNES" white Arial Black 18px — larger
Desc: "The General Theory" grey 12px italic
Dot: 26px circle, red #CC0000 fill, 3px white border — biggest dot
Stem: 65px DOWN
Box: 3px solid red #CC0000 border, black fill, 130px wide
Red outer glow ring: 40px diameter circle outline, #CC0000 10% opacity, pulses
NODE 5 — x=1050, ABOVE line
Year: "1944" orange #FF6600 bold 16px
Name: "HAYEK" white Arial Black 15px
Desc: "Road to Serfdom" grey 11px italic
Dot: 16px circle, orange fill, 2px white border
Stem: 55px UP
Box: 2px solid orange border, black fill
YEAR TICK MARKS below gold line at each x position
2px wide, 10px tall vertical tick in grey #555
Year number in grey #555, 10px, below tick
ANIMATION (8 seconds, single-pass, no looping)
0.0–0.5s: Title + subtitle slide down from top, opacity 0→1
0.5–1.2s: Gold timeline line draws left to right (scaleX 0→1, transform-origin left)
1.2–1.7s: NODE 1 (1776) appears — dot scale 0→1, stem grows, box fades in
1.7–2.2s: NODE 2 (1871) appears
2.2–2.7s: NODE 3 (1920) appears
2.7–3.4s: NODE 4 (1936 KEYNES) appears with larger impact — dot bounces scale 0→1.2→1, box fades, red glow ring expands once
3.4–4.0s: NODE 5 (1944) appears
4.0–4.5s: Radiating diagonal speed lines flash briefly across canvas (constructivist energy)
4.5–8.0s: Static hold. NODE 4 glow ring pulses slowly every 1.5s. Subtle paper-grain texture overlay breathes
FONT: Arial Black, Arial, sans-serif ONLY — no external fonts
STYLE: flat hard-edge, no border-radius on boxes, no box-shadow, no gradients on nodes
Complete standalone video — top of canvas is black not transparent

speeches.script: In 2020, governments spent thirteen trillion dollars. Everyone agreed — spend now, worry later
But Japan tried exactly that — for thirty years. Debt hit two hundred percent of GDP. Growth? Near zero
Japan borrowed for thirty years straight. Debt hit 200% of GDP. Growth never came.
From Adam Smith to Keynes — in 1936, one theory gave governments permission to spend.
Keynes published in 1936. Governments loved it. It gave them permission to spend.
Global debt: three hundred fifteen trillion. Inflation wiped savings. Hayek saw this coming.
In 1944, Bretton Woods institutionalized Keynesian demand management as the global standard.
Crisis, stimulus, debt, inflation — then crisis again. The cycle never ends.
Stimulus doesn't solve recessions — it postpones them. Read Hayek. Honest prices, not a manager.
